purpose: Level 2 STRUCTURAL: the Level 1 homepage response was dominated by an image-slideshow bootstrap and did not expose a usable nav-link list directly; a re-fetch of the homepage found a link to the site's own Cargo-hosted RSS feed (https://mothclub.co.uk/rss), which was then fetched to enumerate the site's real page inventory.

rss_request.method: curl -sS -L -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; BandOnTheMapResearch/1.0; +research)' --max-time 20 (single unauthenticated GET; no retries)

notable_finding: MOTH Club DOES have its own first-party, in-nav 'Events' page at https://mothclub.co.uk/Events (confirmed by the RSS feed's own <link> and <guid>). Its content, as embedded in the RSS description, is a DiceEventListWidget.create(...) call carrying a DICE.fm partnerId and apiKey, filtered to venues:['moth club'] -- i.e. the page's event content is a DICE.fm widget embed, not first-party structured event data.
